Nowadays a lot of people think that working from home is better than working in an office. I think there are good things and bad things about it and I'm gonna explain them.

First, working from home saves time because you don't need to travel. You can also spend more time with your family and you can work when you want. But it is not always easy because your family can disturb you and you can feel alone. And it is difficult to separate work and home. And some people work too much because their computer is always there.

In conclusion, working from home is good for some people but not for everyone. Companies should let workers choose. And workers should make a timetable.
